findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_case_passport" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Retrieve the user's persistent CaseMagic record for a saved matter: case identity, parties, docket activity, correspondence and available documents, so that you…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_federal_case, get_case_mail · Private data: find_federal_case, explain_docket_entry, get_case_documents, get_case_deadlines, create_case_passport, get_case_passport, get_case_docket, read_case_document, get_case_mail · Public sink: get_case_mail, send_case_mail · Destructive: read_case_document.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_federal_case, get_case_mail · Private data: find_federal_case, explain_docket_entry, get_case_documents, get_case_deadlines, create_case_passport, get_case_passport, get_case_docket, read_case_document, get_case_mail · Public sink: get_case_mail, send_case_mail · Destructive: read_case_document

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
